title: Ayam Tinoransak - Manado Spicy Braised Chicken
ldName: Ayam Tinoransak - Manado Spicy Braised Chicken
ldKeywords: Spicy braised chicken from Manado, Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Indonesian spicy chicken stew without coconut milk.
Indonesian spicy chicken stew with lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves.
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 lemongrass, bruised and cut into 2 inch lengths
8 kaffir lime leaves, remove the ribs
8-10 chicken drumsticks, or a whole chicken cut into 8 pieces
1 tablespoon palm sugar, or to taste
ldInstructionsRaw: Heat oil in a pot and sauté spice paste, turmeric powder, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add chicken pieces, stir, and cook until no longer pink.

Pour the water into the pot, season with salt and sugar, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is tender and fully cooked, and the sauce has somewhat reduced. Adjust salt and sugar as needed.
Turn off the heat and serve immediately with steamed white rice.
